The seat of Pest County is Budapest, but Budapest is not part of Pest County: the capital is a separate unit with the same rank as the counties.
Budapest is the capital: it belongs to no county.
The vármegye is one of the oldest units of Hungarian administration: the name was used from the founding of the state until 1950.
In 1950, when the council system was introduced, the vármegyék became megyék, and that name stayed in use for more than seventy years.
From 1 January 2023, after the eleventh amendment of the Fundamental Law, the official name of the counties was vármegye again, and the heads of the county government offices got the title főispán.
From 1 October 2026, under Act XLIX of 2026, the official name is megye again, and the government office is once more led by a government commissioner instead of a főispán.

That is why the game uses today\'s official word, “megye” (county). The renaming did not change the borders, the seats or the number of counties: the country is still made up of 19 counties and the capital, Budapest.

Every correct answer is worth 100 points times the multiplier. After three correct answers in a row the multiplier goes up by one (at most ×5); a mistake or a hint drops it back to ×1. A hint costs 50 points and can be used once per game. You have 3 lives: every wrong tap (in Towns mode, a guess more than 15 km off) costs one, and when they run out the game is over. If you reach the end (without giving up and with a life left) you get a time bonus. In Towns mode distance counts: full points within 5 km, nothing from 75 km.
Do I need internet to play?
No. Internet is only needed to register, sign in and see the global leaderboard. Results from games played offline are uploaded automatically later.
I forgot my password. What can I do?
As we don\'t ask for an email address, the password cannot be reset. Create a new account and use a password manager.
How can I delete my account?
With the “Delete account” button in Settings. Your results on the leaderboard are deleted together with the account.
Why can\'t I see the county names while playing?
Because they would give the answer away. You can see the names in Explore mode and here, in Learn.
Is Budapest the seat of Pest County?
Yes, but Budapest is not part of Pest County: the capital is a separate unit with the same rank as the counties. So in County seats mode both are correct.
